passages.note: Senate roll call 8 on HB 1032 third reading; Bray voted Nay and the bill was defeated.
Engrossed bill text shows the general assembly would redraw congressional maps and restrict court review of apportionment challenges.
Bill details page confirms the Senate third reading of HB 1032 was defeated 19-31 on 12/11/2025; Bray is not listed as an author or sponsor.

rows.reasoning: Bray voted Nay on HB 1032 (2026), a Senate-defeated bill that would have let the general assembly redraw congressional districts mid-decade, established new district maps, and restricted court review of apportionment challenges; a No vote on this bundled redistricting bill shows only that he opposed this specific measure, not which of the ladder's rungs on who should draw boundaries he holds.
